nphi.summary: RIVM leads the national inventories of high-risk biological materials and contributes pandemic surge-capacity tools, including the SCAT e-learning.

nphi.with: Partner institutions in the Lancang-Mekong subregion
nphi.summary: Network launched in 2025 at the RNAS+ annual meeting, with an MoU signed by NIPD to link tropical-disease laboratories of the five Mekong countries on shared objectives, target diseases and a work plan.

nphi.title: Lao TPHI – Khon Kaen University MoU on liver fluke and cholangiocarcinoma
nphi.actor: Lao Tropical and Public Health Institute (Lao TPHI, formerly NIOPH)
nphi.with: Khon Kaen University – Cholangiocarcinoma Research Institute
nphi.summary: Lao TPHI and Khon Kaen University's Cholangiocarcinoma Research Institute signed an academic cooperation MoU in Vientiane on liver fluke infection and bile duct cancer, within the Mekong-Lancang-funded 'Combatting Cholangiocarcinoma in…

nphi.title: CSIRO/ACDP partnership program under Partnerships for a Healthy Region
nphi.actor: CSIRO Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness (ACDP)
nphi.with: Animal health laboratories in Southeast Asia; Pacific field diagnostic networks
nphi.type: Programme (DFAT Partnerships for a Healthy Region)
nphi.summary: AUD 24.2m CSIRO program (over AUD 12m via ACDP) strengthening animal health laboratories in Southeast Asia, testing at high-risk sites such as wildlife markets and boosting Pacific field diagnostic networks.

nphi.title: Pac-EVIPP+ – Pacific Evidence for Informed Policies and Programs Plus
nphi.with: Pacific Community (SPC); Fiji National University; SAFETYNET; ASEAN+3 FETN; ministries of health
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded AU$7.5 million programme (2024–2028) to build the applied field epidemiology workforce in Pacific Island countries, Cambodia and Laos through advanced FETP pathways, mentorship and communities of practice.

nphi.title: SHEPERD – Strengthening Health Emergencies Preparedness and Enhancing Response to Disease Outbreaks
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: Lao Ministry of Health (Dept. of Communicable Disease Control; National Centre for Laboratory and Epidemiology); Hanyang University College of Medicine
nphi.summary: KDCA-funded bilateral ODA that builds Lao laboratory systems and hospital-based surveillance for acute febrile illness and gastroenteritis. In 2026 it held the first Korea–Laos MERS tabletop exercise.

nphi.title: KDCA support to ASEAN infectious disease early warning and risk assessment
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: ASEAN Secretariat
nphi.summary: Funds and supports the operation of an ASEAN regional system for infectious disease early warning and risk assessment.

nphi.title: SATREPS: malaria and neglected parasitic disease control/elimination in Laos (NCGM)
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur du Laos; Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: NCGM-led SATREPS project with Institut Pasteur du Laos and the Lao Ministry of Health on control and elimination of malaria and neglected parasitic diseases.

nphi.title: CDC Southeast Asia Regional Office
nphi.with: Host ministries of health; ASEAN
nphi.summary: CDC's SEA regional office in Hanoi (2021) coordinates seven bilateral country offices and ASEAN partnerships on AMR, One Health, border health, lab systems, emergency management and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: ACPHEED – regional ASEAN centre for public health emergencies (Thailand, Indonesia, Viet Nam)
nphi.actor: ASEAN Centre for Public Health Emergencies and Emerging Diseases (ACPHEED), secretariat hosted by Thailand
nphi.with: ASEAN Member States' health ministries; Japan-ASEAN Integration Fund (JAIF); Australian Government
nphi.summary: Regional ASEAN centre announced in November 2020 and set up across three host countries, with the secretariat office in Thailand and further hubs in Indonesia and Viet Nam; Japan committed US$50 million and Australia AU$21 million to…

nphi.title: APCOVE – Asia Pacific Consortium of Veterinary Epidemiology (phases 1 and 2)
nphi.with: Australian and New Zealand veterinary schools; national animal health services
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded consortium set up in 2020 to build veterinary epidemiology capacity for animal and zoonotic disease surveillance in eight Asia-Pacific countries.

nphi.title: ARIA-RISE – Regional Immunisation Support and Engagement
nphi.actor: National Centre for Immunisation Research and Surveillance (NCIRS) – Australian Regional Immunisation Alliance (ARIA)
nphi.with: 20+ Australian research institutions (Menzies, MCRI, Burnet, Kirby, ANU, Telethon Kids); WHO; UNICEF; Gavi; regional ministries of health
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded alliance hosted by NCIRS that supports immunisation programmes in the Pacific and Southeast Asia, including COVID-19 vaccine roll-out plans, measles outbreak support and immunisation training (RISE-2 continuing).

nphi.title: CAPTURA – Capturing data on AMR patterns and trends in use in regions of Asia
nphi.with: CAPTURA consortium; Fleming Fund (UK aid); national AMR surveillance sites
nphi.summary: Fleming Fund regional grant, run from IVI's platform since 2019, that gathers historical AMR and antimicrobial-use data and trains national teams on prescribing surveys, WHONET analysis and surveillance monitoring.

nphi.title: ASEAN Emergency Operations Centre Network for public health emergencies
nphi.actor: Ministry of Health Malaysia (lead, ASEAN EOC Network)
nphi.with: Public health emergency operations centres of ASEAN Member States
nphi.summary: Network of national public health EOCs set up by ASEAN Member States around 2017 to coordinate emergency preparedness and response, later led by Malaysia; it held regional meetings and tabletop exercises during COVID-19.

nphi.title: Mitigation of Biological Threats (MBT) in the ASEAN Region Program
nphi.actor: Global Affairs Canada (Weapons Threat Reduction Program)
nphi.with: ASEAN Secretariat; ASEAN EOC Network; ASEAN BioDiaspora Virtual Center; ACPHEED; PHAC (participant)
nphi.summary: A Canadian-funded ASEAN programme, running since 2014, that strengthens regional biosafety, biosecurity, surveillance and preparedness. It helped set up the ASEAN EOC Network and the BioDiaspora Virtual Center. Phase 3 (2024–2027) was…

nphi.title: ASEAN+3 Field Epidemiology Training Network (ASEAN+3 FETN)
nphi.actor: Ministry of Public Health, Thailand (Department of Disease Control)
nphi.with: FETP programmes of ASEAN Member States and China, Japan, Korea; ASEAN Secretariat
nphi.summary: Regional network linking field epidemiology training programmes across ASEAN and China, Japan and Korea, set up in Bangkok in 2011 with Thailand's Ministry of Public Health endorsed as focal point.

nphi.title: SEAOHUN – Southeast Asia One Health University Network
nphi.actor: Southeast Asia One Health University Network (SEAOHUN), Chiang Mai University
nphi.with: 67 universities in national One Health university networks; USAID; KOICA; US Department of State
nphi.summary: Regional university network founded in 2011, with its secretariat at Chiang Mai University, that builds the One Health workforce through curricula, exchanges, fellowships and joint projects in Southeast Asia.

nphi.title: Mekong Basin Disease Surveillance (MBDS) network
nphi.with: Ministries of health / disease control departments of the six Mekong Basin countries; MBDS Foundation
nphi.summary: Regional network founded in 2001 under a health-ministerial MoU linking six Mekong countries for cross-border surveillance, outbreak investigation and response, information sharing and capacity building; secretariat c/o Thailand's DDC.

nphi.title: Microbiology for Development (phase V)
nphi.with: Lagos University Teaching Hospital; Institut Pasteur de Bangui; Institut de Recherche en Sciences de la Santé (Burkina Faso); Institut Pasteur du Laos
nphi.summary: Training programme running since 2000, funded by Luxembourg's foreign ministry and LIH, hosting visiting scientists from African and Lao institutes for microbiology research.

nphi.title: IMR as SEAMEO TROPMED Regional Centre for Microbiology, Parasitology and Entomology
nphi.with: SEAMEO TROPMED Network
nphi.summary: IMR has hosted the SEAMEO TROPMED regional centre for microbiology, parasitology and entomology since 1967, running regional diploma courses for Southeast Asian health professionals; it is also a WHO collaborating centre for vector…

nphi.title: CDC Laos country programme
nphi.with: Lao Ministry of Health; Lao FETP
nphi.summary: CDC has worked in Laos for nearly 20 years, supporting the MOH with the Lao FETP (est. 2009), emergency response and genomic sequencing, border health, influenza surveillance and PEPFAR HIV work.

nphi.title: China–Laos–Cambodia Accelerated Schistosomiasis Elimination Cooperation Project
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: Center for Malariology, Parasitology and Entomology (CMPE), Laos; National Center for Parasitology, Entomology and Malaria Control (CNM), Cambodia
nphi.summary: South-South project funded by the Asian Cooperation Fund in which NIPD experts support Laos and Cambodia in eliminating Mekong schistosomiasis through field missions, surveillance and lab support.

nphi.title: Pasteur Network (Institut Pasteur International Network)
nphi.with: Pasteur Network members incl. Institut Pasteur de Dakar, de Bangui, de Côte d'Ivoire, de Guinée, du Maroc, de Madagascar, de Tunis, d'Algérie, du Cambodge, du Laos, Korea, Montevideo, São Paulo; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; CERMES Niger; Fiocruz; NIHE, Pasteur Institutes Nha Trang and Ho Chi Minh City; Pasteur Institute of Iran; HKU-Pasteur Research Pole; Sciensano; Stephan Angeloff Institute; Hellenic Pasteur Institute; Institut Pasteur in Saint Petersburg
nphi.summary: Global network of about 33 public health and research institutes in 25 countries and territories, many of them national reference laboratories or NPHIs, collaborating on infectious disease surveillance, research and training.

nphi.title: China–Vietnam–Laos cross-border infectious disease emergency response drill
nphi.with: Vietnam Administration of Disease Prevention (Ministry of Health); Lao Ministry of Health Department of Communicable Disease Control; China NDCPA; Yunnan emergency response teams
nphi.summary: China's disease control administration and China CDC's Health Emergency Center ran the first full-scale trilateral exercise with Vietnam and Laos, simulating an outbreak of a new acute infectious disease in the shared border area. The…

nphi.title: China NDCPA – Lao Ministry of Health talks on communicable disease cooperation
nphi.actor: National Disease Control and Prevention Administration (NDCPA)
nphi.with: Lao Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: A delegation from China's National Disease Control and Prevention Administration met Lao Ministry of Health leaders in Vientiane to strengthen bilateral cooperation on communicable disease prevention and control. The meeting prepared a…

nphi.title: China CDC – GOARN Tier 1.5 and training-of-trainers workshop for Asian responders
nphi.with: WHO Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN); Guangdong Provincial CDC; national public health agencies of the participating countries
nphi.summary: China CDC and GOARN ran a three-day workshop in Guangzhou on deploying international public health emergency teams. It covered GOARN Tier 1.5 training and training of trainers for participants from eight ASEAN countries, Sri Lanka and…

nphi.title: ICMR-NIV mpox diagnostic training for South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.with: Health and laboratory staff of nine South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.summary: During the 2022 mpox outbreak, ICMR-NIV Pune trained health workers from nine Asian countries in mpox testing, case definitions, sample collection and lab equipment. It also offered testing kits, reagents and probes on request.

nphi.title: IndoPacLab – strengthening laboratory and diagnostic capacity in the Indo-Pacific
nphi.with: Burnet Institute; Doherty Institute; CHAI; FIND; PNG National Laboratory Technical Working Group
nphi.summary: AUD 5.2m consortium funded via Australia's Global Fund contribution and the Indo-Pacific Centre for Health Security to strengthen national and peripheral laboratory and diagnostic capacity in PNG, Cambodia and Laos.

nphi.title: China CDC – ASEAN (Plus Three) public health emergency tabletop exercises
nphi.with: National health authorities of ASEAN member states; ASEAN Secretariat; Malaysia NIH Biobank; Singapore public health laboratory
nphi.summary: A series of online workshops and tabletop exercises for ASEAN health authorities: health emergency response under ASEAN+3 (2021), IT-supported outbreak investigation (2022), and preservation and use of pathogen resources (2025).

nphi.title: Multi-country emergency operations project (DGHP-iEOC Phase IV, TCLM)
nphi.with: Thailand–US CDC Collaboration; ministries of health of Cambodia, Lao PDR and Malaysia
nphi.summary: DDC-led multi-country project with US CDC support strengthening emergency operations centres in Thailand, Cambodia, Lao PDR and Malaysia, with tabletop exercises among ASEAN countries.

nphi.title: ASEAN-Australia Health Security Fellowships (Master of Applied Epidemiology)
nphi.with: ASEAN ministries of health; DFAT
nphi.summary: Fellowship programme agreed after the 2018 ASEAN-Australia Special Summit, in which ASEAN health officials complete ANU's applied epidemiology degree while working in their home institutions and Australian fellows do field placements in…

nphi.title: JICA Project for Capacity Development for Medical Laboratory Network (biosafety and highly hazardous pathogens)
nphi.with: National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology (NIHE); Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City; Pasteur Institute Nha Trang; Tay Nguyen Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology
nphi.summary: A JICA technical cooperation project with Japan's NIID (now part of JIHS) as the cooperating institution. It strengthened NIHE's laboratory network, biosafety and BSL-3 capacity, and piloted training in Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia.

nphi.title: Lao NIOPH – Ramathibodi (Mahidol University) academic cooperation MoU
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health (NIOPH), Lao PDR
nphi.with: Faculty of Medicine Ramathibodi Hospital, Mahidol University

nphi.with: National Institute of Public Health (NIOPH), Lao PDR
nphi.summary: NCGM's Bureau of International Health Cooperation (now JIHS) carries out joint research with Lao PDR's National Institute of Public Health, sends advisors, and acts as secretariat for related Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW)…

nphi.actor: China CDC (China Field Epidemiology Training Program)
nphi.with: NHFPC International Exchange and Cooperation Center; ministries of health of ASEAN member states
nphi.summary: China CDC's field epidemiology training programme ran short field-epidemiology courses in Beijing for ASEAN health staff. The courses were part of the China–ASEAN Public Health Talent Cultivation 100-Person Plan (2014–2017), commissioned…

nphi.title: SATREPS: genetic epidemiology of malaria and parasitic diseases in Laos (NCGM)
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur du Laos; Center of Malariology, Parasitology and Entomology (CMPE), Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: Earlier NCGM-led SATREPS project with Institut Pasteur du Laos and the Lao CMPE on the genetic epidemiology of malaria and other parasitic diseases.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 027 – Bio-risk management in Laos and Thailand
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur du Laos; WHO; Expertise France; Thai Ministry of Public Health
nphi.summary: EU-funded project with Institut Pasteur, Institut Pasteur du Laos and WHO introducing laboratory biorisk management to Thailand's public health laboratory network and strengthening biosafety policy in Laos.

nphi.title: APEIR – Asia Partnership on Emerging Infectious Diseases Research
nphi.actor: Universitas Indonesia, Faculty of Public Health (APEIR coordinating office)
nphi.with: Researchers, practitioners and senior officials in member countries; Connecting Organizations for Regional Disease Surveillance (CORDS)
nphi.summary: Regional research partnership founded in 2006 linking researchers and government officials in six Asian countries on emerging infectious diseases and their burden on poor and marginalised groups; a member network of CORDS.

nphi.title: Thailand NIH regional laboratory collaboration
nphi.summary: In an IANPHI-funded project, Thailand's NIH worked with labs in Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar and Bhutan on techniques, biosafety and external quality assurance. In 2012 it coordinated with Cambodia and Vietnam on hand, foot and mouth disease…

nphi.title: PaReCIDS II – Lao-Luxembourg partnership for infectious disease surveillance
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur du Laos; National University of Laos; Lao Red Cross
nphi.summary: Luxembourg Ministry- and LIH-supported partnership for research and capacity building in infectious disease surveillance in Laos, in its second phase by 2019.

nphi.title: Canada-Asia Regional Emerging Infectious Diseases (CAREID) project
nphi.with: Ministries of Health; National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology (NIHE, Vietnam); Philippine Department of Health / San Lazaro Hospital; CIDA (funder)
nphi.summary: A CAD 4.3 million, CIDA-funded project led by PHAC that built capacity to detect and respond to emerging infectious diseases in Southeast Asia. PHAC ran its biosafety pillar, including biorisk management training and work with Vietnam's…

nphi.title: SISEA – regional initiative to strengthen epidemic response capacity in Southeast Asia
nphi.actor: National Center for Laboratory and Epidemiology (NCLE), Lao PDR

nphi.summary: A regional initiative building coordinated surveillance of respiratory infections and acute encephalitis; NCLE's director sat on its four-member steering committee and NCLE hosted steering committee meetings in Vientiane in 2008.
